Messages.Author: chrisn101
Messages.Body:
One of our local players occasionally plays an "Anarch  Ian ". Tricksy little deck that does quite well.

If your local group play ally or reaction-card-dependant decks,  Safe passage is quite effective. Doesn't cost anything, but any reaction card played cost a blood or life more. Add a  Sabbat Priest or similar effect card to Ian and that could be quite a nice little combo.

Messages.Author: Louhi
Messages.Body:
Ignoring very common ones like Deflection, Voter Captivation and Daring the Dawn (that are great nonetheless), a few that pop up in my head are: Tangle Atropos' Hand, Form of Corruption, Nocturn, Will-o'-the-Wisp (maybe too straightforward), Blessing of Chaos, Scalpel Tongue (sorry Ian), Touch of Clarity and False Resonance. There's loads more and it obviously depends on the archetype you want to play. Anarch do have plenty but most aren't that strong so I actually haven't considered them.

Lidingö Scourge

Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
Army of rats and taking the skin:minion

Seriously though, Typhonic beast, terror frenzy, taunt the caged beast, nose of the hound, and some cards become used slightly differently at basic, such as mind of a killer becoming just a rush enabler at basic.
Some cards, like devil channel throat work fine for its cost and gives an extra perk at superior. Sirens Lure still kind of does what you want at basic, but superior is a no-brainer if you can choose

I'm not a fan of Forestall, but I've wanted to build a Gwydd summon history deck for awhile. Forestal does plenty, but even with support, it feels like a Mata hari deck with summon history.
